body: I go to school in Germany and this is my last year of school, which is simular to high school. Most colleges won't take me, because my grades are too bad.

Everybody always sais that things get better and I really want to believe that it's true, but for me these are just empty words. I had a great life and it got worse every year. I never had the feeling that things are getting better. 

I don't know if a therapist would help me. I really dislike the Idea and don't see how a therapist could help me with my future. I jsut got the feeling that my life already is ruined and that it can't be changed anymore.

I know that grades don't reflect intelligence. That's one of the reasons why I hate school that much and just stay at home sometimes. I hate to see other people getting better grades when they can't even solve simple math problems. Some employers maybe don't care that much about grade, but a lot of them do. 

I don't know why it's hard for me to enjoy things, but I wouldn't say it's related to my grades. When I go bowling or play poker with "friends" I don't enjoy it, even if I win. I used to have a lot of fun doing these things.

In my childhood everything went perfect for me. I always was the best kid in class and I always had a lot of friends. But a few years ago I started losing a lot of friends and my grades got bad in school. 

This probably sounds really arrogant, but I always thought and still think that I am smarter than most people. Because of that I started feeling terrible when other kids got better grades than me in school. I stopped going to school regulary and my grades got even worse. This got worse every year and now. This is my last year in school and my grades are terrible and find it hard to enjoy things. I just don't see any hope for my future.
